Forward plant-and-open to kick stance makes controlled forward arrival into an open hip position the rotational anchor, paired with the compact arc of Rotational shadow hook. Ankle Pogo in Place — short bilateral set introduces six consecutive small ankle contacts after the earlier separated jump receptions; these contacts support foot organization and ankle force, rather than adding a running approach. Compared with Class 5, prescribed bilateral foot-landing events change from 3 to 6, low-amplitude foot landings (a subset of foot landings) change from 0 to 6. Review actual recovery and require a free foot-and-hip turn plus small rhythmic ankle receptions with a controlled final stop. If rhythmic landing is unconfirmed, replace only the remaining pogo attempts with the listed grounded quick calf rises and log zero replacement landings. Shorten the rotational step or hand arc when alignment fails, preserving full between-task recovery.
